linhas.en:
Rani's first SG.

The desire to reject any tolerance of waste
and operate systems efficiently.

Though not "the desire to control others," in extremes,
Management Desire can be worse than Controlling Desire.
It ultimately brings forth people under the control of
misguided rules, raised in a misguided city of the future―
――a dystopia, but that's another story.

             ◆

Rani VIII is a measurement freak.
She takes pleasure in seeking orderly patterns,
eliminating ambiguity, and quantifying everything.
As a homunculus, Rani acknowledges her shameful humanity,
shutting herself in her room to indulge in numerics.
It seems Rani herself hasn't noticed that this is
one of her few hobbies and idiosyncrasies.

On a side note, its opposite is the "Submission Desire" SG.
Rin & Rani. Though they're like oil and water, they may
get along since they're like parts missing from each other.
